extensions.name: Prayer Times
extensions.tagline: Times and reminders for your city
extensions.description: Shows the next prayer and a countdown in the notch, lists today’s times, and can remind you before each one. The times are Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı’s own, from the EzanVakti API; a month is kept on this Mac, so it works offline.
extensions.author: Orilio contributors
does: Next prayer and countdown in the ear
